title: Golden-set sample labels (samples/golden/<id>/expected.json)
description: Verified expected output for one real remittance, scored by scripts/golden_eval.py. Payment lines live next to it in expected-lines.csv (columns: pro,amount; PRO exactly as written in the source, amount to the cent). The folder is git-ignored: customer files and customer-derived labels are never committed.

source.description: File name of the .msg/.eml in the sample folder.

verified.description: null while the labels are a draft from pipeline output; set by `golden_eval.py verify` after a person checks them against the source.

notes.description: What makes this sample interesting, and any business rule its labels depend on.

metadata.description: Only the fields listed are scored.

issues.description: Expected triage issue ids (e.g. payer:negative_amount_paid). Omit to skip scoring issues.
